g.text: Independent sessions with different routes, inputs and durations; observed peaks are not paired A/B effect sizes.
Curves end at the last observation; no extrapolation. Both panels start at zero; memory metrics overlap.
Current shared texture retention still grows. This comparison makes no FPS or five-hour stability claim.
